```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE,
                       fig.align = "center", fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4)

if (!exists("project_folder")) {
  project_folder <- getwd()
  pipeline_folder <- getwd()
  features_file <- "config/features.yaml"
  sample_file <- "config/samples.tsv"
}

source(file.path(pipeline_folder, "workflow", "scripts", "R", "report_helpers.R"))
ma_dir <- file.path(project_folder, "results", "mag_annotate")
```

# Genome quality (CheckM2)

```{r checkm2-summary, results='asis'}
checkm2_df <- safe_read_tsv(file.path(ma_dir, "checkm2", "quality_report.tsv"))

if (nrow(checkm2_df) == 0) {
  cat("_No CheckM2 output found yet._\n")
} else {
  n_hq <- sum(checkm2_df$Completeness >= 90 & checkm2_df$Contamination <= 5, na.rm = TRUE)
  cat(sprintf(
    "**%d** genomes assessed; mean completeness **%.1f%%**, mean contamination **%.1f%%**; **%d** meet the >=90%% complete / <=5%% contaminated (MIMAG high-quality draft) threshold.\n\n",
    nrow(checkm2_df), mean(checkm2_df$Completeness, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean(checkm2_df$Contamination, na.rm = TRUE), n_hq
  ))
  preview_table(
    checkm2_df[, intersect(c("Name", "Completeness", "Contamination", "Genome_Size", "GC_Content"), colnames(checkm2_df))],
    n = nrow(checkm2_df), caption = "CheckM2 quality per genome"
  )
}
```

```{r checkm2-plot, fig.height=4}
if (nrow(checkm2_df) > 0) {
  ggplot(checkm2_df, aes(x = Contamination, y = Completeness)) +
    geom_point(colour = "#00B5E2", size = 2) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 90, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 5, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
    labs(title = "Genome quality (dashed lines = MIMAG high-quality draft threshold)",
         x = "Contamination (%)", y = "Completeness (%)") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
}
```

# Taxonomic classification (GTDB-Tk)

```{r gtdbtk-summary}
gtdbtk_df <- safe_read_tsv(file.path(ma_dir, "gtdbtk", "gtdbtk.summary.tsv"))

if (nrow(gtdbtk_df) == 0) {
  cat("_No GTDB-Tk output found yet._\n")
} else {
  gtdbtk_df$phylum <- sub(".*p__([^;]*);.*", "\\1", gtdbtk_df$classification)
  preview_table(
    gtdbtk_df[, intersect(c("user_genome", "classification"), colnames(gtdbtk_df))],
    n = nrow(gtdbtk_df), caption = "GTDB-Tk taxonomy per genome"
  )
}
```

```{r gtdbtk-plot, fig.height=4}
if (nrow(gtdbtk_df) > 0) {
  phylum_counts <- gtdbtk_df %>% count(phylum, sort = TRUE)
  ggplot(phylum_counts, aes(x = reorder(phylum, n), y = n)) +
    geom_col(fill = "#78BE20") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(title = "Genomes per phylum", x = NULL, y = "Number of genomes") +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 11)
}
```

# Assembly quality (QUAST)

```{r quast-summary}
quast_report <- file.path(ma_dir, "quast", "report.tsv")
if (file.exists(quast_report)) {
  preview_table(safe_read_tsv(quast_report), n = 30, caption = "QUAST assembly statistics")
} else {
  cat("_No QUAST report found yet._\n")
}
```
